title: Vuln8: Unsigned Integer Wraparound and Assertion Failure in fossildelta deltaparsevtabColumn Bounds Check
expected: bounds check rejects the oversized INSERT count; no assertion
actual: sqlite3.c:93001: sqlite3_result_blob: Assertion `n>=0' failed; core dumped

title: Unexpected result by RIGHT JOIN with a UNIQUE INDEX
bug_query: SELECT t0.c2 FROM v0 RIGHT JOIN t0 ON t0.c0 WHERE t0.c2 IS (SELECT count(*) FROM t0 AS x WHERE x.c0 = v0.c0);
actual: 1 row: 0

title: Possible signed integer overflow in sqlite3Update() with extreme number of indexes
expected: index-count arithmetic in sqlite3Update() cannot overflow
actual: nIdx/pParse->nTab could overflow signed int at ~INT_MAX indexes; developer: not reachable, no known issue

title: bug(constraints): `ALTER TABLE` silently changes meaning of SQL it doesn't rewrite, leaving a stale partial index
bug_query: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT b FROM t WHERE rowid>1);
expected: 0, agreeing with the NOT INDEXED scan (0)
actual: 2 via the stale partial index; only REINDEX fixes it, VACUUM propagates it

title: lifelineVuln2: Repeated vfsstat initialization makes the default VFS wrapper self-referential
actual: VFS wrapper points at itself; infinite recursion, ASan stack-overflow on next file operation

title: json_extract returns different subtype under index
bug_query: SELECT json_array((SELECT json_extract(j,'$.x') FROM t1 WHERE a=1));
expected: subtype 74 and [[1,2]], as with NOT INDEXED
actual: subtype 0 and ["[1,2]"] when the index is used

title: Unexpected result from row-value IN with min()
bug_query: SELECT c1 FROM t0 WHERE (((c1),(c1)) IN (SELECT c.c1, min(c.c1) FROM t0 AS c));
actual: 0 rows

title: Unexpected Results from json_array() with an Indexed json_extract() Expression
bug_query: SELECT json_array(+json_extract(j,'$.x')) FROM t1 WHERE a=1;
actual: ["[1,2]"] once the index exists

title: Vuln70-51: FTS3 fts3IncrmergeLoad (int) Cast Truncates nLeafEst, Suppressing Leaf Flush During Incremental Merge
expected: nLeafEst = +134217728, leaves flushed during incremental merge
actual: nLeafEst = -134217728; no leaf flush, merged blocks step backward and may overwrite segments

title: lifelineVuln8: simple tokenizer silently ignores the sole delimiter argument (argv[0]) and falls back to default delimiters
expected: a single delimiter argument "b" splits 'abcabc' into a, ca, c
actual: sole argument ignored, default delimiters used ('abcabc' kept whole); developer: leave it as it is

title: Vuln48-29: FTS5 NEAR Query Heap Use-After-Free via In-Place Poslist Rewrite Realloc
expected: the NEAR query returns a count
actual: ASan heap-use-after-free read in sqlite3Fts5PoslistNext64 via fts5ExprNearIsMatch

title: Vuln7: Signed Integer Overflow and Heap Out-of-Bounds Read in fossildelta delta_parse INSERT iNext Computation
expected: the oversized INSERT count is rejected by the nDelta bound test
actual: negative iNext bypasses the bound test; ASan SEGV in deltaGetInt

title: Incorrect result of json_extract when the key contains NUL
actual: 1 (the key comparison stops at the NUL)

title: Vuln68-49: OR-to-IN Conversion Loses Column Collation in src/whereexpr.c exprAnalyzeOrTerm
bug_query: SELECT t2.val FROM t1, t2 WHERE t1.a = t2.val OR t1.b = t2.val;
expected: hello, world (2 rows), as without the index
actual: 0 rows once the index enables the OR-to-IN rewrite

title: Vuln2: Signed Integer Overflow in FTS3 NEAR Operator Distance Parsing
actual: UBSan: signed integer overflow: 2147483647 + 1 cannot be represented in type 'int'

title: Vuln80-61: Heap Buffer Overflow in FTS3/FTS4 fts3EvalDeferredPhrase
expected: the deferred-phrase merge buffer is large enough for every column
actual: ASan heap-buffer-overflow WRITE of size 1 in sqlite3Fts3PutVarint (nPoslist+8 too small past 8 columns)

title: Vuln79-60: Heap Out-of-Bounds Read in ext/misc/spellfix.c spellfix1FilterForMatch Missing nPattern>0 Guard
expected: an empty MATCH pattern is handled without reading out of bounds
actual: ASan heap-buffer-overflow read of zPattern[-1] in spellfix1FilterForMatch

title: Vuln53-34: FTS5 fts5IndexTombstoneRebuild Signed Integer Overflow on Corrupt Tombstone nElem Field
expected: a corrupt tombstone nElem cannot overflow the slot-count arithmetic
actual: UBSan: signed integer overflow: 536870912 * 4 cannot be represented in type 'int' (release: benign)

title: SQLite `compress()` UDF unchecked allocation NULL write DoS
expected: compress() returns SQLITE_NOMEM when the output allocation fails
actual: store to NULL pointer at ext/misc/compress.c:67, ASan SEGV in compressFunc

title: Two-argument substr() with a large negative start drops characters from the end
expected: 'abcdefghij' (whole string, as for every ordinary negative Y)
actual: 'abcdefghi' - |Y| minus SQLITE_LIMIT_LENGTH characters silently removed from the end
